review: Actual original-avatar Unity sampling produced 291 rendered frames and three continuous 60 FPS movies. The native right-hand stick is held diagonally forward, the free arm remains independent, knees are compressed and feet stay under the asymmetric stance. Chest/neck/forearm breathing produces 9.7 mm maximum hand travel and a closed loop. Humanoid retargeting produces 3.43 mm uncorrected ankle motion; the original root and leg channels are retained. Full paired timeline contact, moving-board IK and guard transitions are still pending.
integration_status: Native original project contains isolated staging asset only; active finale definition unchanged.
